projects.title: External Single-IP Penetration Test
projects.description:
I need a thorough black-box, unauthenticated penetration test against one public static IP. Your first step will be full port and service discovery, followed by an in-depth examination of every service you uncover. While doing so, please pay particular attention to any security appliance or filtering layer in front of the host; I want to know if you can fingerprint, evade, or otherwise work around it.

For the web portion, test only the HTTP/HTTPS services that live on this IP—no user accounts or credentialed access will be provided. The goal is to see what an external attacker can learn or exploit straight from the open interface.

Deliverables
• Executive summary that highlights key risks and recommended fixes in plain language.  
• Detailed technical report containing step-by-step methodology, tools used (e.g., Nmap, Nikto, Burp Suite, Metasploit, or similar), proof-of-finding artifacts (screenshots, commands, response dumps), and remediation guidance.  
• All issues must be ranked from Critical to Low severity so I can triage quickly.

I will provide the target IP once we agree on scope and timeline. Let me know your estimated duration, any prerequisites, and how you prefer to share interim updates.

projects.title: 100 Tasks to $100M Blueprint
projects.description:
I run an online product-oriented business that already has paying customers, but growth has started to plateau. My goal is bold yet straightforward: engineer a clear, step-by-step path—roughly one hundred well-defined tasks—that can take the company from its current level to a valuation or revenue run-rate of one hundred million dollars.

What I need from you is not generic advice, but a structured, data-driven plan that I can execute and track. Each task should state its objective, the resources or tools required (think analytics, automation, paid acquisition platforms, CRO frameworks, partnerships, viral loops, etc.), an estimated timeframe, and a measurable KPI so progress is unmistakable.

To keep the blueprint actionable, please:

• Group tasks logically by phase (foundation, acceleration, scale) while maintaining a single numbered sequence so nothing is missed.  
• Highlight any critical decision points where alternative strategies may be chosen.  
• Reference proven growth frameworks—AARRR funnel, North Star metric alignment, OKRs—where they add clarity, but keep jargon minimal.  
• Include brief risk notes and mitigation ideas for any task where failure would stall momentum.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. A deliverable document (PDF or shared Notion/Google Doc) containing ~100 sequential tasks, each with objective, KPI, and resource/tool notes.  
2. A one-page executive summary that shows the expected growth curve and how the milestones ladder up to the $100M goal.  
3. The plan must start from an existing customer base (assume modest but real traction) and emphasize speed of execution without sacrificing sustainability.

If this sounds like a challenge you’re ready for, let’s talk strategy and timelines.

projects.title: Pair Engineers for Restaurant Booking MVP
projects.description:
Bids are valid only through our test. Bids without a completed test and its receipt number will not be considered.

Test: https://artusihabibot.com/dev-assessment/
Access passphrase: Nazimerd

About the project
Artusi Ħabibot is a multilingual, chat-first restaurant booking assistant: users find a place, request a table and receive a real confirmation and a reminder. We start on Telegram and will extend to WhatsApp and voice calls. No app download. The goal is a working MVP in a pilot city in Italy.

Who we are looking for
Two lead engineers who will work together in pair programming and practise test-driven development (failing test first, then code, then refactor). Tests are how we agree scope and acceptance, so management stays light. No one approves their own work: each lead reviews the other’s evidence.
Main stack: Python (aiogram, async), PostgreSQL, LLMs via OpenRouter or open models, telephony and speech-to-text/text-to-speech for voice.

Phases and budget (per person)

Phase 1 – Plan validation: USD 50. Complete the plan together and confirm the development scope, the infrastructure, telephony and AI costs, and a realistic marketing and user-acquisition hypothesis.
Phase 2 – Build: USD 200, starting in December. Only if the Phase 1 plan is validated.
Phase 3 – Pilot: USD 200, starting in January.

Fixed payments go through Freelancer.com milestones, released for accepted and tested deliverables. Beyond the fixed budget, compensation is a revenue fee per confirmed booking with a cap, or shares for those who want to stay in the project long term.

How to apply

Open the test, enter the passphrase above and your email, and type the 6-digit code you receive.
Answer four technical challenges and a cost plan for calls and AI (sourced unit prices, monthly totals, cost per booking), plus your motivation, proposed economics and an AI-use declaration. Drafts are saved automatically.
Submit once and quote your receipt number (HB-…) in your bid, together with your weekly availability for pairing and your time zone.

The evaluation criteria and weights are visible inside the test before you answer.

Important: the name on your Freelancer.com profile and the name on the email account you use for the test must match. Mismatching identities will be reported to Freelancer.com.
